knowledge_graph.title: Bupa Dental Care Kidderminster
knowledge_graph.type: Dental implants periodontist in Kidderminster, England
knowledge_graph.address: 8 Church St, Kidderminster DY10 2AD, United Kingdom
knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Our friendly dental implant clinic, situated in Stourport-on-Severn, is dedicated to placing dental implants. Implant services include single and multiple implants, implant-supported dentures and bridges, and full-arch implant treatments. We offer supporting procedures such as bone grafts, soft tissue grafting and 3D CBCT scans, and accept referrals from other dentists. If you’re nervous we can provide dental sedation. Our practice has free parking and is a 25-minute drive from Worcester. Bupa has added a new dental allowance to self-paying private health insurance policies. This includes one appointment at a Bupa Dental Care practice and £300 towards restorative treatments for everyone on your policy per year. Contact us to find out more."

related_questions.question: Can you use any dentist with Bupa Dental?
related_questions.snippet: Do I have to use a Bupa dentist? You can choose to see any dentist, whether it's for private or NHS treatment, or you can visit one of our Bupa Dental Care practices. Using a dentist within the Bupa Dental Insurance Network opens up benefits such as discounts, Instant Claim and access to trusted expertise.
